transcript.text: I need to flag a restriction on track 7, 'Night Transit.' Tessa, you're telling me the artist agreement requires an October 18, 2026 release date — not October 4 — and the credit must read exactly 'Featuring Inez Vale' on the album listing.

Both of these issues need to be resolved before I can approve the package. Let me ask: Elias, are there any other tracks with licensing restrictions I should know about, or is track 7 the only one? And Tessa, are there any other artist agreement requirements beyond the date and credit wording? I want to make sure we've surfaced everything before I record my decision.
